hooks.command: node -e "const c=require('node:child_process'),p=require('node:path'),r=c.execFileSync('git',['rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();const candidates=[p.join(r,'.venv',process.platform==='win32'?'Scripts/python.exe':'bin/python'),'python3','python','py'];for(const x of candidates){const t=c.spawnSync(x,['-c','import sys; sys.exit(len(sys.argv)!=2)','probe'],{stdio:'ignore'});if(t.status===0){const z=c.spawnSync(x,[p.join(r,'scripts/hooks/skill_routing_context.py'), 'session'],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(z.status===null?1:z.status);}}process.stderr.write('Hook failed: no working Python interpreter. Run the repo bootstrap.');process.exit(1);"
